question: Does the complementary voter have recognizably local areas of expertise? The preceding three-input linear correction was positive in only two of five held folds; here the new signal is actual disagreement outcomes on semantically similar comparisons.
features: Use only the frozen sentence representation belonging to the voter elected in the earlier supervised audition. Compare unit-normalized sentence midpoints by cosine and signed edit directions by absolute cosine. Their equal mean is independent of which option is presented first. For each disputed example use at most one nearest observed disagreement per shared-title group. Use the nearest ceil(sqrt(number of available fitting groups)), bounded between 3 and 24, with nonnegative squared similarity weights. Start from the difference in absolute binary log odds used by the fixed equal vote. Correct its implied probability of listening to the new model by the observed neighbor residuals, shrunk with three average-weight zero-residual neighbors. No hyperparameter search. Leave agreements and exact corrected ties unchanged.
control: Compare the properly matched case histories with the unaltered 50/50 combination and a negative control. In each learning rotation shuffle the training disagreement examples' semantic row identities with a fixed seed, leaving their labels, baseline confidence, and case groups together. Apply completely identical training, confirmation and deployment rules in both arms. A gain from a general confidence adjustment or chance alone does not establish that case content matters.
evaluation: Reuse exactly the three group-disjoint roles and genuine out-of-fold predictions of the prior routing study, never any upstream classifier trained on its routing-role rows. Enable each correction only if its independent confirmation role beats the protected equal vote. Audit each row once per assignment. Run the second assignment only if the first real routing result is positive, beats the shuffled-content control and wins at least three of five folds. Require +0.20 percentage points on each assignment, at least seven positive folds and repeated superiority to the content shuffle before any next prospective application. The new rule was designed using prior results from the same known corpus.
usage: Zero new base-model fits or downloads and zero model API. At most 60 small feedback reference sets across both real and placebo arms. No designated validation, test or H2.
